result.paraphrase: Seagate Exos 7E2000 2TB internal 2.5-inch hard drive, part number ST2000NX0253, is a SATA 6 Gbps HDD with 512-byte sectors. It offers 2TB storage, a single interface port, and 128MB buffer, and supports 6.0/3.0/1.5 GB/s interface speeds. Performance specs include 136 MB/s maximum sustained transfer, 4.16 ms average latency, and 7200 RPM rotation. Designed for a 3.5-inch x 1/4H internal bay, it has a 1.4 million hour MTBF, PowerChoice on-demand power, protection information, low halogen, RAID rebuild, and an AFR of 0.63%.
